verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly support per-key concurrency limits (e.g., per user id) via step concurrency keys, and separate hard rate-limiting on function runs within a time period, directly enabling per-tenant/per-key throttling to prevent one hot customer from starving others. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence validating multi-tenant fairness at scale, and no explicit combined example of concurrency+rate-limit used together per tenant in production.
